verdict.rationale: Expensify's SmartScan is documented to OCR receipts in real time (merchant, date, total, currency) via camera capture, but hands-on community reports contradict the polish of this claim: users report categorization is wrong ~70% of the time unless obvious, that scans took ~20 minutes to process, and that outsourced (MTurk) human review was used behind the scenes with data accuracy not guaranteed. There is also no evidence in the pack for the 'forward an email' capture path. missing for 10: evidence of email-forward receipt capture, independent verification of categorization/filing accuracy against transactions, resolution of the community-reported OCR/categorization failures.
